title: Tesla expands robotaxi service to San Antonio

claims.claim: Tesla is expanding its robotaxi service to San Antonio starting at 5 a.m. local time on Monday.

evidence.quote: The company said in a post on X that it will make its robotaxis available in San Antonio starting at 5 a.m. local time on Monday.

Tesla is expanding its robotaxi service to another Texas city as it seeks to compete with Waymo and position itself as more than just an automaker. The company said in a post on X that it will make its robotaxis available in San Antonio starting at 5 a.m. local time on Monday.

claims.claim: Tesla launched a robotaxi service in Austin in June 2025.

evidence.quote: it eventually launched a robotaxi service in Austin in June 2025.
Tesla CEO Elon Musk for a decade promised his company would deliver autonomous vehicles, and it eventually launched a robotaxi service in Austin in June 2025.

claims.claim: In January, Tesla removed safety monitors from its robotaxis in Austin to start a true driverless service.

evidence.quote: In January, the company removed safety monitors from its robotaxis in Austin, officially kicking off a true driverless service

claims.claim: Tesla currently operates robotaxis in limited areas of Miami, Orlando, Dallas, Fort Worth, and Houston.

evidence.quote: It now operates robotaxis in limited areas of Miami and Orlando as well as Dallas, Fort Worth, and Houston.

claims.claim: Waymo operates a robotaxi service in Austin, Dallas, Houston, and San Antonio using Jaguar I-Pace and Zeekr RT vehicles.

evidence.quote: Its rival Waymo also operates a robotaxi service using a mix of driverless Jaguar I-Pace and Zeekr RT vehicles, branded Ojai, in Austin, Dallas, Houston, and San Antonio.

claims.claim: Tesla has more than 400 autonomous vehicles registered in its Austin fleet.

evidence.quote: While Tesla has more than 400 autonomous vehicles registered in its Austin fleet

While Tesla has more than 400 autonomous vehicles registered in its Austin fleet, its fleets in other cities have numbered between a handful and a few dozen, according to Texas vehicle registration data and the Robotaxi Tracker website.

claims.claim: Tesla has 24 vehicles in Fort Worth and five in Miami according to the tracker.

evidence.quote: For example, Tesla has just 24 vehicles in Fort Worth and five in Miami, according to the tracker.

claims.claim: Tesla operates a ride-hailing service with a human behind the wheel in the San Francisco Bay Area.

evidence.quote: Tesla also has a ride-hailing service, under a transportation charter permit, that it operates in the San Francisco Bay Area. While the vehicles are often described as robotaxis, they are operated by a human behind the wheel.
